answer: Rovers that wander across basalt to sample comet debris need scheduled radio slots. Give each bid one lottery ticket only after a fixed fee is burned on-chain. Validators check the burn amount and round, verify that the ticket names the bidder key, and reject a burn receipt already used by any bidder. Every ticket has the same weight, and new accounts get none for free. A fleet of aliases seeking 100 tickets must destroy 100 fees, just like one bidder seeking 100 tickets.
